name: Casa Sarita
area: Park Hyatt Goa Resort & Spa, Arossim Beach, Cansaulim
signature_dish: goan fish curry with red rice
why_it_matters: The Park Hyatt's signature Goan fine-dining room — colonial-villa interiors with mosaic flooring, mother-of-pearl windows and an open show kitchen. Currently helmed by Chef Sarita Pereira whose grandmother's recipes drive the menu, making it the most credible hotel-grade Goan kitchen on the southern beach belt.
insider_tip: Order the chorizo pao as a starter, then split the fish curry-rice thali for two — most plates are large. The bebinca is house-made daily, never the bought-in supermarket version.
signature_address: Park Hyatt Goa Resort & Spa, Arossim Beach, Cansaulim, South Goa 403712

name: Spice Studio
area: Alila Diwa Goa, Adao Waddo, Majorda
why_it_matters: Alila Diwa's flagship coastal-Indian room, set around a 100-year-old banyan tree on the resort's edge. The menu hopscotches the southwest coast — Kerala backwaters to Mangalore to Goa — using regionally specific spice masalas rather than a generic 'south Indian' cliche.
insider_tip: Sit in the open-air section facing the paddy field at sundown. The chef's coastal thali sampler is the best way to taste three regions in one sitting; ask for off-menu fish of the day.
signature_address: Alila Diwa Goa, 48/10 Adao Waddo, Majorda, Salcete, South Goa 403713

name: Hosa
why_it_matters: Chef Suresh DC's modern South Indian flagship — opened late 2022 by Rohit Khattar's Old World Hospitality (the Indian Accent group). High-ceilinged Portuguese villa with riverfront terrace; the menu spans Pondicherry, Coimbatore, Nellore, Kollam and Chettinad with Western technique. Ranked on Asia's 50 Best Discovery list.
insider_tip: The bar (Best Concept Bar West India, NDTV Food Awards 2025) deserves its own visit — go for cocktails at 7pm, dinner at 9pm. Terrace tables overlooking the Anjuna River are the prime real estate.
signature_address: Opposite St Anthony's Chapel, Vaddy, Siolim, Bardez, North Goa 403517

name: Spice Traders
area: W Goa, Vagator Beach Cliff, Vagator
why_it_matters: W Goa's flagship pan-Asian room — two-storey, perched on the Vagator cliff with an open-air rooftop terrace looking straight onto the Arabian Sea. Anchored on China's eight regional cuisines (Sichuan, Cantonese, Hunan) rather than the generic 'Indian Chinese' default.
insider_tip: Arrive 30 minutes before sunset for a Woobar cocktail first, then move to the rooftop. The Sichuan section of the menu is genuinely spicy — say so if you want it dialled down.
signature_address: W Goa, Vagator Beach Road, Vagator, Bardez, North Goa 403509

name: Kebabs & Kurries
area: ITC Grand Goa, Arossim Beach, Cansaulim
why_it_matters: ITC's heritage North-Indian and Awadhi room at the Grand Goa — same culinary philosophy as Bukhara/Dum Pukht in the ITC stable, executed by Lucknowi-trained chefs (Chef Farhan currently leading). The Goa outpost is the only place in the state to get this calibre of dum-style cooking.
insider_tip: Order one signature from the kebab platter (galouti) plus one from the kurries (raan or biryani) — the kitchen staggers cooking times, so don't order everything at once. Vegetarian dal bukhara is non-negotiable.
signature_address: ITC Grand Goa, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Arossim Beach, Cansaulim, South Goa 403712
